page_title: Godmode — your computer work, done for you

sources.entry: Godmode Bot - Open-source AI coworker that turns your Claude subscription into persistent agents that do computer work in their own browser with your logins. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/codextde/godmode-bot)

summary.name: Godmode
summary.one_liner: Godmode is a paid AI coworker app, powered by Claude, that carries out computer tasks such as emails, invoices, spreadsheets and shop orders in your own browser and desktop apps using your saved logins.
use_cases: answer customer emails and where-is-my-order queries
pull ad reports from Meta, Google and TikTok Ads
fill the same web form for many customers
summary.what_it_does: Godmode takes a task described in plain language and operates the browser and desktop apps the way a person would, clicking, typing and signing in. It uses the user's own logins, imported from Chrome, and fills passwords and 2FA codes from an encrypted local vault so the AI sees only that a value was filled. Tasks can run on a schedule, when an email arrives, or when something changes, and can be messaged from Slack, Telegram or Microsoft Teams. The user can watch each step live, take over, or stop a task, and the app asks before important actions. The page also describes a team of named specialist agents (invoice collector, inbox triage, research, social media and others) that the main agent can create.
notable: Uses your own signed-in browser and apps, with no per-app connector setup
Built-in AES-256-GCM encrypted vault for passwords and 2FA codes that the AI never sees in plaintext
Scheduled and event-triggered runs, messaged via Slack, Telegram or Teams
Optional separate Mac on your Mac for running tasks in isolation
caveats: Requires a Claude Pro or Max plan or an Anthropic API key, which is not included in the Godmode price
Paid after a 14-day free trial; the page lists $39/mo or $348/yr, with launch offer pricing that ends October 31
On the separate Mac, it controls the whole machine and signing in there is best effort
Claims in the comparison table are the vendor's own and were checked on October 22, 2026
